The '''Tosh family''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] family from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. In the last [[Standard year/Legends|decades]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], it consisted of [[Gar Tosh]], his [[Marriage/Legends|wife]] [[Plena Tosh|Plena]] and their [[Youngling/Legends|children]] [[Jann Tosh|Jann]], [[Gessle Tosh|Gessle]] and [[Trif Tosh]]. They also had a relative named [[Pedric Tosh]], who had served in the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], Jann Tosh was orphaned when he lost his [[Parent/Legends|parents]] and sibling in a [[Skimmer/Legends|skimmer]] accident.
